tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel what is still pending of a scheduled task. It stops nothing already running.

task.description: The task, by its T label.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List the person's work: what is running, the scheduled tasks still pending, and the scheduled work that ended most recently.

tools.name: look_up_activation
tools.description: See what running work you were shown as running has found and done so far.

activation.description: The running work, by its E label.

tools.name: spawn
tools.description: Set up work that runs later or separately: a scheduled task, which starts an activation of its own when it falls due, reading what it carries. Give at most one of at, delay_minutes, after and rule; with none it falls due now.

instruction.description: What the task's activation is to do, in your own words.

at.description: When it falls due: an ISO 8601 local date and time with no offset, such as 2026-10-25T20:00, read in the person's zone, or in zone; or an instant with its UTC offset, such as 2026-10-25T20:00:00-04:00.

delay_minutes.description: When it falls due: this many minutes from now.

after.description: When it falls due: once every one of these tasks has ended, by T label.

places.description: The places it suggests speaking in, by L label.

replaces.description: A pending task this one replaces, by T label.

rule.description: When it falls due, again and again: a rule, at a local time of day in the person's zone, or in zone. Only for a task the person asked for.

repeats.description: Every day, Monday to Friday, or weekly on days.

days.description: The days of the week a weekly rule falls on.

time.description: The local time of day, 24-hour, such as 07:00.

from.description: A local date, such as 2026-10-27, before which none falls.

until.description: The last local date one may fall on, such as 2026-11-30.

zone.description: The IANA zone at or rule is read in, such as Europe/Lisbon, only where the person named one.

tools.name: stop_activation
tools.description: Stop running work you were shown as running, and that work alone. Nothing it already did is undone, and what it set up stays. The result shows what it had finished and what it set up that is still live.

activation.description: The running work, by its E label.
